name: serenity
readme_excerpt: SerenityOS Graphical Unix-like operating system for 64-bit x86, Arm, and RISC-V computers. FAQ | Documentation | Build Instructions About SerenityOS is a love letter to '90s user interfaces with a custom Unix-like core. It flatters with sincerity by stealing beautiful ideas from various other systems. Roughly speaking, the goal is a marriage between the aesthetic of late-1990s productivity software and the power-user accessibility of late-2000s \nix. This is a system by us, for us, based on the…
